---
title: "Research using ggseg"
subtitle: "Studies citing ggseg in their work"
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script type="module">
        import { getCitingWorks, renderCitations } from '../js/citations.js';

        const container = document.getElementById('citations-grid');
        const countEl = document.getElementById('citation-count');
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('citation-search');
        let allWorks = [];

        getCitingWorks().then(works => {
          allWorks = works;
          container.classList.add('fade-in-up');
          renderCitations(works, container, countEl);
        });

        searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          const query = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
          const filtered = allWorks.filter(w => {
            const authors = (w.authorships || []).map(a => a.author?.display_name || '').join(' ').toLowerCase();
            const title = (w.title || '').toLowerCase();
            const journal = (w.primary_location?.source?.display_name || '').toLowerCase();
            const year = (w.publication_date || '').substring(0, 4);
            return title.includes(query) || authors.includes(query) || journal.includes(query) || year.includes(query);
          });
          renderCitations(filtered, container, countEl);
        });
      </script>
---

<span id="citation-count">...</span> studies have cited ggseg in their research.
Data sourced from [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org/){target="_blank"}, updated live.

::: {.atlas-search-box}
<label for="citation-search">Filter studies</label>
<input type="text" id="citation-search" placeholder="Search by title, author, journal, or year..." />
:::

::: {#citations-grid .citations-grid}
<div class="skeleton-grid">
<div class="skeleton-card"><div class="skeleton-line medium"></div><div class="skeleton-line short"></div></div>
<div class="skeleton-card"><div class="skeleton-line medium"></div><div class="skeleton-line short"></div></div>
<div class="skeleton-card"><div class="skeleton-line medium"></div><div class="skeleton-line short"></div></div>
</div>
:::
